Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the great session last week. We captured a short 30-second highlight of the demo where your team walks through the predictive scheduling flow. We'd love to promote that snippet alongside the GoldLeaf logo on Redwood's LinkedIn and X accounts as part of a customer spotlight post next Tuesday (9/22).

Summary of ask:
- Use a 30s clip (trimmed) from the 9/10 demo.
- Display GoldLeaf logo (color) in the post image and embed the clip in the post.
- Copy we plan to use (proposed): "How GoldLeaf Health cut scheduling time by 35% using Redwood Inference — watch a quick demo."

Attachments: goldleaf-demo-30s.mp4 (video/mp4), goldleaf-logo-color.svg

Can you confirm:
1) Permission to use the clip and logo for organic social (LinkedIn + X/Twitter)?
2) Any mandatory attribution language or brand guidelines/constraints we should follow?
3) If you prefer a different snippet or copy, happy to adjust — deadline to lock copy is Monday 9/21 EOD.

If easier, please loop in your legal/brand person and we can send a short permission form.

Thanks —

Alex Martinez
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
